messages:
maya: Heads-up: onnxruntime flagged a parsing vuln — CVE-2026-0456. Vendor advisory shows RCE via model config parsing. We need to decide hotfix scheduling for hosted and Dedicated/Private. https://vendor.example/notice

sam: :eyes: thanks. Severity? any exploit telemetry yet?

maya: Vendor marks HIGH (RCE). No confirmed customer exploits in our telemetry but active PoC chatter externally. Affects runtime versions 1.8.x that accept user model uploads. Hosted model catalog models not affected.

leo: Clarifying: only endpoints that allow custom model ingestion are vulnerable, right? Not our default inference endpoints.

maya: Correct. Hosted custom-model upload flow + some older private images.

ursula: Prioritization thinks: because there's external PoC, treat as urgent for hosted custom-model path. Customer exposure is segmented — Dedicated/Private are higher risk business-wise. Recommend hosted hotfix within 24-48h.

maya: Proposed rollout plan:
1) Emergency hotfix image for hosted runtime -> next maintenance window (02:00 UTC, ~18h).
2) Canary 5% for 30m, monitor errors and latency, then 25% for 1h, then full if green.
3) Dedicated customers: prepare patch bundle + notify; schedule rolling patch across reserved clusters over next 7 days.
4) Private/on-prem: provide backport + instructions; coordinate direct CS support.

sam: Need telemetry and rollback plan. Also we should enable extra audit logging around model loads and KMS accesses for 72h post-rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: hotfix-onnx-176950 -> scheduled for maintenance window 1769580000 (02:00 UTC)

leo: Possible SLA effects: expect small token-latency increase during cache warm (150-300ms spikes) and ~1% increased model-load latency. Not an outage risk, but runbook should state abort if latency >500ms or errors >1%.

sam: Prep smoke tests and rollback image. Smoke test command:
```bash
./smoke_test.sh --image redwood/onnx-hotfix:176950 --timeout 60
```

leo: I'll add metric alerts: model-load-error-rate > 1% and token-latency > 500ms. Also add a trace to identify any KMS key failures.

ursula: CS action: notify Dedicated/Private customers via account leads, post an advisory to the status page with affected paths, and create a support playbook. Compliance wants the CVE logged and the audit trail exported.

maya: Assigning owners: maya (security), sam (oncall/deploy), leo (runtime/metrics), ursula (CS/comms). I'll open the release PR with changelog + CVE reference and draft the customer notice.

sam: ack. I'll stage rollback image and bake smoke tests.

leo: Rolling timeline: hosted canary in ~18h, full roll <= 24h if green. Dedicated patch windows scheduled over next week; we'll prioritize high-tier customers first.

maya: Added runbook snippet for abort: if model-load-error-rate > 1% for 10m OR 5+ KMS failures in 5m -> rollback image and notify #incidents.

ursula: I'll queue customer outreach after PR is merged.

maya: (reacted :thumbsup:)
